environment.tool: manual audit of the tag source + live compiled binary; distinct per-file marker content so the opened file is unambiguous, service-side slice arithmetic recomputed by hand

findings.description: The parser forces the trailing slash, which removes exactly the slack the slice needs. S08 404 (prefix miss), S09 403 (component `..` refused), 0/14.
findings.title: Negative: the parser forces alias and location to end in `/`, so `/al..` misses the location and component `..` is refused

limitations: Filesystem read only; all RCE remains on the upstream host
Alias must be configured; several builds additionally need a slashless location
methods: Read the release source from the tag
Diffed the release source against the staged copy (identical)
Plain alias control and root control first on the same cold server
Marker text proves which file opened, never the status code

author_attested: analysis metadata reconstructed after the run
verified: release tag resolves to the submitted source
source SHA-256 and report and evidence hashes
